Dialog.Name: Callough
Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Dialog.Name: Callough
Dialog.Text: What's that? You need a stick? A hard path of dust you've been walkin', as far as my eyes can see. So, I'll make you a fine stick and a Wooden Shield, if you'll but do some good work.

Dialog.Name: Callough
Dialog.Text: If you'll gather some branches from down south of the inn, or even better, from the East Woodlands, I'll have you a fine stick--and a Wooden Shield to boot.

Dialog.Name: Callough
Dialog.Text: Thank ya. Run along and get six branches. I'll take the best one and craft your bludgeoning wood. Don't be too long.
